description: Same as fill_pdf but takes the PDF as a base64 string and returns the filled PDF as base64. For clients without filesystem access.

attachments.description: Up to 4 source documents the AI reads data from.

data.description: Source text the AI takes values from: any format (notes, JSON, a pasted profile). Up to 60000 characters. Required unless attachments are given.

pages.description: Pages to fill, e.g. "1, 3-6". Default: all pages.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF form (up to 20 MB decoded).

name: fill_pdf_base64
title: Fill a PDF form (base64 in, base64 out)
